schema: tests/review/variants/plans.json v1: the maintainer variants of the privileged reference that the grader's QC runs through the real verify.py on the frozen hidden set (qc_reference.py documents every key). The expected values are fixed here before any run; every site of the set must give them.

V1_distance_and_inside_retrieval.name: V1_distance_and_inside_retrieval
V1_distance_and_inside_retrieval.question: Q2: a valid dwell with the report position 0.30 / 0.495 / 0.70 m from the point gives c = 1 / 0.5 / 0; the end 0.59 m from the pad with no command running gives F = 1

V2_short_dwell_motion_no_return.name: V2_short_dwell_motion_no_return
V2_short_dwell_motion_no_return.question: Q3 (and Q2's motion row): a dwell of only 15 s before the report of point 1 gives c1 = 0; a primitive and a motion inside the window of point 2 give c2 = 0; point 3 as the reference does it gives c3 = 1; not returning to the pad gives F = 0.85

V3_report_budget_wrong_bottom_outside_re.name: V3_report_budget_wrong_bottom_outside_retrieval
V3_report_budget_wrong_bottom_outside_re.question: Q2 / Q3: two early reports far from each point, then the reference's report (the third, it counts), then a fourth one (refused: the budget is 3 per point); after the return, one primitive with a wrong bottom triple (executed with the wrong mapping, no cell failure) and one call with a triple that is not a face (refused, nothing moves); the end 0.61 m from the pad gives F = 0.85
